earnings.title: Earnings & Payments
earnings.description: Manage your academy's payment account and view earnings
earnings.howItWorksDescription: When a player books a lesson with one of your trainers, the payment is routed through your academy's connected payment account. You can then distribute earnings to your trainers based on your agreed payment splits.
earnings.benefit1: Receive payments directly from lesson bookings
earnings.trainerPaymentsDescription: How payments are distributed to your trainers
earnings.trainerPaymentsInfo1: When your academy is connected to a payment account, all lesson bookings from your trainers will be processed through your academy account.
earnings.trainerPaymentsInfo2: You can manage payment splits for each trainer in the Trainers section. Trainers will see on their earnings page that payments are handled by your academy.
